text:
zara (PM): quick follow-up from today's all-hands: can we lock a simple delta for API -> Console -> Optimize so partners get one clear line? owners + canary windows please.

li (CTO): top-level: API canary first, small and monitored; Console after API is stable; Optimize beta can roll during Console stabilization. owners: API=miguel, Console=anya, Optimize=zara.

miguel (Eng): API plan: 24h canary @2% -> expand to 12% if no alerts, then 7-day observation before GA. deploy cmd: `./deploy api --ver 2.5.0 --canary --pct 2`. will attach runbook.

anya (DevEx): doc impact: avoid breaking SDK signatures. new Optimize flags should be optional. doc freeze: API docs 48h before GA. I'll schedule a 30m "what's changing" drop-in for partners.

zara (PM): can we get security check and telemetry decision noted? Optimize telemetry for Private must be opt-in.

guards-bot: Security checklist created: https://internal/checklists/optimize-telemetry (owner: security).

li (CTO): agreed, telemetry off by default for Private. also surface dedicated autoscale in Console (infra ticket incoming).

miguel (Eng): noted infra work. will not ship breaking API changes. will post canary ticket with dashboard links.

zara (PM): thanks all — I'll publish the one-liner to partners after canary start time is confirmed.

anya (DevEx): will follow up with docs PR and calendar invite.
